parameters.query:
WITH inserted_row AS (
  INSERT INTO ai_process_log (
    record_id, supplier, material, quantity, status,
    missing_fields, process_step, created_at, workflow_name, workflow_version
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4::integer, $5,
    $6::jsonb, $7, NOW(), $8, $9
  )
  ON CONFLICT (record_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING record_id, status, missing_fields
)
SELECT record_id, status, missing_fields, TRUE AS inserted FROM inserted_row
UNION ALL
SELECT t.record_id, t.status, t.missing_fields, FALSE AS inserted
FROM ai_process_log AS t
WHERE t.record_id = $1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted_row);
